'When this defends an attack, it gets -1{p}.' Generic Defense Reaction.

The release note settles the pronoun: 'it' is the ATTACK Drag Down defends against, not Drag Down itself ('That attack will get the prescribed power decrease when this triggered effect resolves'). MODIFY_ATTACK (effect_types.py:4123, reads mod + amount) adjusts state.combat.attack_power, which during defence IS the attack being defended against; as a one-shot trigger it appends to combat.power_mods so the -1 survives later recalculations. Subtraction authored as negative amount per DSL_REFERENCE.

Shape copied from implemented tripwire_trap_red (cru): TRIGGERED + ON_DEFEND is the proven vehicle for 'when this defends' on a defense-reaction card. No conditions - the trigger is unconditional.
